name: postermywall.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.postermywall.com scores 70 out of 100 (C). 6 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 35 pass. Fix first: 50 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 50 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /index.php/m/ai-tools, /index.php/m/ai-background-remover, /index.php/m/ai-subtitle-generator and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 10 elements on /index.php/m/ai-tools, for example .-ai-subtitles > .ai-tool-content > .body-m and .-ai-bg-remover.ai-tool-card:nth-child(2) > .ai-tool-content > .body-m. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: AWSALB, evk_e21f6a0c4e6a4b6a9d3f2b7c1a5e8d94. Without HttpOnly: csrf_cookie. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /index.php/m/ai-tools, /index.php/ai/chat?source=navbar and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Interactive controls must not be nested
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 21 elements on /index.php/ai/chat?source=navbar, for example .spacing-p-b-2 and .iolByLmofAZZbEdkOcwA.JjkBnReB2gTpDZw3LDeA.Zz6foAchmnVnCL3TPcsz:nth-child(1). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Do not put links or buttons inside other links or buttons.

fix.title: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /index.php/m/ai-tools, /index.php/ai/chat?source=navbar, for example .ipgAv8S2oMfxlEFszYEk. Impact: serious.

fix.title: 139 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.
